name: Insexual Awakening 2: Love and Learn
source:
Embark on a brand new journey of fun, sexy times in Insexual Awakening 2: Love and Learn, the next installment in the Insexual Awakening series! Play as Daniel Cummingham, who is starting his first day of the new school year at Amores Academy. Plan out what you do during the day in order to improve your social stats, or hang out with one of the characters in the game and build your relationship with them.

[From [url=https://iathegame.blogspot.com/2020/12/insexual-awakening-2-001-alpha-public.html]Blogspot[/url]]
